pattern: 全然～ない（ぜんぜん～ない）
purpose: Emphasize a complete absence or negation.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
I do not understand this problem at all.
It is not cold at all today.
I could not sleep at all yesterday.
restrictions: Positive colloquial uses exist, but this pattern teaches the standard negative construction.
mistake: The predicate supplies the negative meaning.

segments.role: Emphasize a complete absence or negation. 全然 + negative predicate.
